summary.t: Cofounded Nvidia in 1993 and has run it ever since. Under him, Nvidia’s chips came to dominate gaming and then AI, and in 2025 it became the first company worth $5 trillion.

owns.t: Cofounder, president and CEO since 1993. Owns about 4% of the company, per Forbes.

record.t: Under a trading plan adopted in March 2024, he sold 6 million Nvidia shares from June to September 2024 for more than $700 million. Afterward he held 75.4 million shares directly and 786 million more through trusts and a partnership.
A plan adopted in March 2025 let him sell up to 6 million shares by year-end, worth about $865 million when sales began in June. By Oct. 31, 2025, he had sold more than $1 billion of stock.
He and Lori started the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation in 2007 with 370,000 Nvidia shares worth $12.6 million. By 2025 its assets topped $9.1 billion, by FoundationMark’s count.
He has given Stanford $30 million for an engineering center and, in 2022, gave Oregon State $50 million for a research center that bears his name.

facts.t: He and his cofounders, Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem, planned Nvidia in a Denny’s booth in East San Jose.
Sent to the U.S. at age 9, he ended up at Oneida Baptist Institute, a school in rural Kentucky.
He earned his Stanford master’s degree in 1992 by taking classes at night while working.
His fortune passed $200 billion in October 2026, when Nvidia stock hit a record.

kidsNote.t: Jensen and Lori have two children, Spencer and Madison. Both are adults and both work at Nvidia.

summary.t: Born Lori Mills. She was Jensen’s lab partner in an electrical engineering class at Oregon State, and they married five years later. She co-founded the family foundation with him.

worth.none: No published estimate of her own.

record.t: In June 2025 the couple’s trust gave 440,000 Nvidia shares worth $60 million to their foundation, and half as many shares to a donor-advised fund, an SEC filing showed.

summary.t: Chair and CEO of AMD, Nvidia’s rival in chips. Jensen’s mother is the youngest sister of Su’s maternal grandfather, so the two are first cousins once removed.

owns.t: Runs it as chair and CEO.

summary.t: Opened a cocktail bar in Taipei in 2015 that Forbes listed among Asia’s 50 best bars. It closed in April 2021. He is now a product manager at Nvidia.
Worked in the hotel industry before joining Nvidia, where she works in product marketing.
A chemical engineer at an oil refinery in Taiwan.
